notes.decision: Read as ⲥⲁϫⲉ/ϫⲉ + ⲛⲉⲙⲏⲓ̈ ('with me'). The page opens mid-clause continuing from p.14. Translated as '...with me' assuming the lost preceding text is something like 'He spoke with me' or 'he was with me.' Confidence high that the phrase is adverbial 'with me' modifying a previous verb.
ⲟⲩⲱⲗⲡ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ = 'reveal, uncover.' Lycopolitan ⲟⲱⲗⲡ for Sahidic ⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ/ⲟⲩⲱⲗⲡ. Rendered 'he revealed to me.' Recurs throughout this section as the formula for what the Paraclete disclosed.
'The hidden mystery, that which is hidden from the worlds.' ⲍⲏⲡ = ϩⲏⲡ 'hidden.' The ⲁ- preposition here marks 'from' (concealed-from).

'The mystery of the deep and the height.' ⲡⲛⲟⲩⲛ = the abyss/deep; ⲡϫⲥⲉ/ⲡⲭⲥⲉ = the height. Standard Manichaean cosmological pair (depth–height). The bracketed ⲙⲛ ⲡⲭⲥⲉ is the editor's restoration; agreed.

ⲡⲍⲧⲁⲡ = ϩⲧⲁⲡ ('attack, falling-upon, conflict'). Coupled with ⲙⲗⲁϩ ('battle/strife') and Greek ⲡⲟⲗⲉⲙⲟⲥ ('war'). Rendered 'the mystery of the clash of strife and the war.' The triple terminology emphasizes intensification.

notes.coptic_form: ⲡⲛⲁⲟ̄ ⲛ . . . ⲡⲙ̄ⲗⲁⲍ ⲉⲧⲁ ⲡⲕⲉⲕⲉ ⲥⲁⲣϥ̄ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ
notes.decision: 'The great [...] of the war that the Darkness spread out.' ⲥⲁⲣϥ̄ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ = ⲥⲱⲣ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ 'to spread, scatter, deploy.' The ~3-letter gap after ⲛⲁⲟ̄ likely held a noun like ⲡⲟⲗⲉⲙⲟⲥ-modifier; left as [...].
ⲡⲟⲩⲧⲱⲧ = 'their union/agreement/mingling' (the cosmic mixture of Light and Darkness). ⲥⲉⲍⲟ ⲁⲍⲣⲏⲓ̈ = ⲥⲱϩⲉ ⲉϩⲣⲁⲓ 'to set up, establish.' Translated 'by their mingling, they established this world.'

notes.coptic_form: ⲁ[ϩⲧ]ⲟⲩⲛⲟⲩⲓ̈ⲉⲧ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ⲁⲛ ⲁⲧⲍⲉ ⲉⲧⲁⲩⲥⲙⲛ ⲛⲉⲭⲏⲩ
notes.decision: ⲧⲟⲩⲛⲟⲉⲓⲁⲧ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ = 'show, manifest.' ⲛⲉⲭⲏⲩ = 'the ships' — the cosmic ships (Sun and Moon) that ferry the redeemed Light. Translated 'He showed me also the manner in which the ships were established.'

notes.coptic_form: [ⲛⲟⲩ]ⲧⲉ ⲙ̄ⲡⲟⲩⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ ⲟⲩⲱⲍ ⲛⲍⲏⲧⲟⲩ ⲁⲥⲱⲧϥ ⲙⲡⲟⲩ[ⲁⲓ̈ⲛⲉ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ]
notes.decision: '...so that the gods of Light might dwell in them to filter out the Light.' ⲟⲩⲱⲍ = ⲟⲩⲱϩ 'dwell, set, be placed.' ⲥⲱⲧϥ = 'to filter, strain, refine' — the technical Manichaean term for the redemption-process by which Light is sifted from Matter.

ⲡⲥⲁⲣⲙⲉ = ⲥⲱⲣⲙ ('error, going astray') as substantive. ⲍⲱⲱϥ = Lyc. for ϩⲱⲱϥ ('itself'). ⲧⲁⲡⲟ likely 'fruit/produce' (ⲧⲁϣⲟ?) but uncertain due to following lacuna; rendered 'the wandering itself, with the [...].'
ⲧⲡⲗⲁⲥⲥⲉ from Greek πλάσσειν 'to mold, fashion.' Translated 'the mystery of the molding of Adam.' The form is verbal-noun (ⲧ- + Greek root).
'The Tree of Knowledge.' ⲥⲁⲩⲛⲉ = ⲥⲟⲟⲩⲛ 'knowledge.' Direct reference to Genesis 2-3 reread in Manichaean key.
'His eyes saw outward.' ⲃⲉⲁ = ⲃⲁⲗ 'eye.' ⲛⲉⲩ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ = ⲛⲁⲩ ⲉⲃⲟⲗ. Refers to Adam's eyes being opened after eating from the Tree of Knowledge. Preserved the directional 'outward' of ⲁⲃⲁⲗ.
'They choose the churches' — the apostles select/elect the assemblies they found. ⲥⲱⲧⲡ here means 'choose, elect,' cognate with ⲉⲕⲗⲉⲕⲧⲟⲥ in the next line.

Double-bracketed in transcription = scribal deletion (the scribe wrote this prematurely, then deleted because L18 has the same content in proper sequence). Marked as deleted in translation; included in {{deletion}} marker.
'Of the catechumens, the helpers.' ⲃⲟⲏⲑⲟⲥ = Greek βοηθός. The catechumens (auditors) were the second class of Manichaeans; described as 'helpers' (i.e., supporters of the Elect).
'The punishment that is laid up for them.' ⲕⲟⲗⲁⲥⲓⲥ = Greek κόλασις 'punishment, chastisement.' ⲁⲏⲟ̄ likely from ϩⲏⲟⲩ 'lying / stored / set apart.'
'Everything that has come to be and that which shall come to be.' Standard 'past + future' formula for total disclosure.

ⲡⲣⲕⲗⲥ = abbreviation for ⲡⲁⲣⲁⲕⲗⲏⲧⲟⲥ (the Paraclete). Following lacuna ~5 letters likely ⲙⲡⲙⲏⲉ ('of Truth') — a standard Manichaean epithet ('Paraclete of Truth') — but cannot be confirmed; rendered '[...the Paraclete of...].'
'What the eye looks at and the ear hears.' ⲓ̈ⲁⲣⲍ = ⲉⲓⲱⲣϩ 'to look at, watch' (Lyc.). ⲡⲙⲉϣⲧⲉ = ⲙⲁⲁϫⲉ 'ear.' ⲥⲁⲧⲙⲉϥ = ⲥⲱⲧⲙ 'hear.' Classic 1 Cor 2:9-style formula for total cognition.
'The reflection reflects upon (it).' ⲙⲁⲕⲙⲉⲕ = the fifth faculty 'reflection' (per glossary). The verbal form ⲙⲟⲕⲙⲉⲕ is its cognate verb. Preserved the figura etymologica.
'I saw the All through him.' ⲡⲧⲏⲣϥ = 'the All, the universe, the totality.' ⲛⲧⲟⲟⲧϥ = 'through his hand/agency.' Refers to seeing all things through the Paraclete.

notes.coptic_form: ⲁⲓ̈ⲣ̄ ⲟⲩⲥⲱⲙⲁ ⲛⲟⲩⲱⲧ ⲙⲛ ⲟⲩⲡⲛ̄ⲁ̄ ⲛⲟⲩⲱⲧ
notes.decision: 'I became one body and one spirit (with him).' Famous Manichaean autobiographical formula expressing Mani's union with his heavenly Twin/Paraclete. ⲡⲛ̄ⲁ̄ = ⲡⲛⲉⲩⲙⲁ 'spirit.'
'In the last years of Ardashir.' ⲧⲍⲁⲏ = ϩⲁⲏ 'end, last.' ⲣⲙⲡⲉⲩⲉ = ⲣⲟⲙⲡⲉ 'year' (plural). Ardashir I (r. 224–242 CE), founder of the Sasanian dynasty.

'I sailed/crossed to the country of the Indians.' ⲭⲓⲟⲣⲉ = ϫⲓⲟⲟⲣ 'to cross over (a river/sea).' ⲛⲍⲛⲧⲟⲩ = the Indians (cf. Greek Ἰνδοί). Refers to Mani's first major mission, the famous voyage to India.
'I chose in that place a beautiful election.' i.e., founded a community of the Elect. ⲥⲁⲛⲓⲧ = ⲉⲥⲛⲁⲛⲟⲩⲥ 'beautiful, good.' The figura etymologica (ⲥⲱⲧⲡ/ⲙⲛⲧⲥⲱⲧⲡ) preserved.

notes.coptic_form: ⲍⲛ̄ ⲧⲣⲁⲙⲡⲉ ⲇⲉ ⲍⲱⲱϥ [ⲉⲧⲁ ⲁⲣⲧⲁ]ⲝⲟⲟⲥ ⲡⲣ̄ⲣⲟ ⲙⲟⲩ
notes.decision: 'But in that very year [in which] Ardashir the king died.' ⲣⲁⲙⲡⲉ = ⲣⲟⲙⲡⲉ 'year.' Historical anchor: Ardashir's death = ca. 242 CE.
'Shapur his son became king.' Final lacuna ~5 letters; possibly ⲁϩⲭⲱⲕ ⲁⲃⲁⲗ ('he was crowned/perfected') but uncertain; rendered as '[...]'.

notes.coptic_form: ⲁⲓ̈ⲭⲓⲟⲣⲉ ⲭⲛ ⲛⲧⲭⲱⲣⲁ ⲛⲛⲍⲛⲧⲟⲩ ⲁⲡⲕⲁⲍ ⲛⲛⲡⲉⲣⲥⲏⲥ
notes.decision: 'I sailed from the country of the Indians to the land of the Persians.' ⲭⲛ = ϩⲛ here functioning as 'from' in motion-context. ⲡⲉⲣⲥⲏⲥ = the Persians.
'To the land of Babylon, Mesene.' ⲙⲁⲓ̈ⲥⲁⲛⲟⲥ = Mesene (Greek Μεσήνη), the region at the head of the Persian Gulf. Geographical sequence: India → Persia → Babylon/Mesene.
'The country of (Beth-)Hozeos' = Khuzistan/Susiana. Standard Manichaean geographical term for the southwestern Iranian region.

notes.coptic_form: ⲁⲓ̈ⲟ[ⲩ]ⲱⲛⲍ̄ ⲁⲥⲁⲡⲱⲣⲏⲥ ⲡⲣ̄ⲣⲟ ... ⲁϩⲍⲗⲗⲟ ... ⲇⲉⲭⲉ ⲙⲙⲁⲓ̈
notes.decision: 'I appeared before Shapur the king. He [...] received me with great honor.' ⲟⲩⲱⲛⲍ = ⲟⲩⲱⲛϩ 'appear, reveal oneself.' ⲇⲉⲭⲉ = Greek δέχομαι 'receive.' ⲁϩⲍⲗⲗⲟ uncertain — possibly Lyc. perfect 'he ascended/welcomed' — but the main verb ⲇⲉⲭⲉ controls. Rendered '[...] received me.'

ⲁϥϯ-ⲙⲁ ⲛⲏⲓ̈ = 'he gave place to me' i.e. 'he granted me leave.' ⲧⲁⲙⲁⲍⲉ uncertain — possibly ⲁⲙⲁϩⲧⲉ 'grasp, seize' or 'walk through' — likely 'to traverse / preach.' Rendered 'he granted me leave to traverse.'
'[Preac]hing the word of life.' ⲥⲉⲭⲉ = ϣⲁϫⲉ 'word.' ⲡⲱⲛⲍ = ⲡⲱⲛϩ 'life.' Standard Manichaean kerygmatic formula.

'I spent some other years [following] him in the comitatus.' ⲕⲟⲙⲧⲁⲧⲟⲛ = Latin comitatum (via Greek), the imperial royal retinue/entourage. Mani traveled in Shapur's military court. The lacuna at start of L34 likely held a participial form like 'following him' or 'with him.'

proposed_terms.rationale: Plural of ⲉⲭⲏⲩ/ϫⲟⲉⲓ 'ship, vessel.' In Manichaean cosmology, the 'two ships' = the Sun and Moon, vessels that ferry the redeemed Light particles upward. Translation 'ships' preserves the technical sense; 'vessels' would be acceptable but less concrete.

Verb ⲥⲱⲧϥ = 'to strain, filter, refine.' Technical Manichaean term for the cosmic process by which Light particles are sifted from Matter through the celestial machinery. Distinct from ⲥⲱⲧⲡ ('choose'). 'Filter out' captures the strain/refinement semantics.

Abbreviation/Coptic spelling of Greek παράκλητος. The advocate/comforter spirit; in Manichaean theology, this is the heavenly Twin who descended to Mani. Standard transliteration retained as proper title.

Latin loanword (via Greek κομιτᾶτον) referring to the imperial military retinue. Mani traveled with Shapur's court. 'Comitatus' is technically precise; 'royal retinue' is the natural English equivalent.
Lycopolitan form of Sahidic ϫⲓⲟⲟⲣ — to cross (water). In context of Mani's missions to India and back, this means sea travel. 'Sail/cross' preserves the maritime sense.
Lycopolitan ⲧⲍⲁⲏ = Sahidic ϩⲁⲏ 'end, last, latter (part).' Used in temporal phrase 'the last years of Ardashir.' Standard sense.

translation:
[L1] ...with me. He revealed to me the hidden mystery, [L2] that which is hidden from the worlds and the generations: the mystery of the Deep [L3] [and the Heigh]t. He revealed to me the mystery of the Light [L4] and the Darkness; the mystery of the [clash of stri]fe and the wa[r] [L5] and the great [...] of the war which the Darkness spread out; aft[erward] [L6] he revealed to me also in what manner the Light [...] [L7] the Darkness, by their mingling — they established this world [...]. [L8] He sh[ow]ed me also the manner in which the ships were established, [so that the] [L9] [god]s of the Light might dwell within them, to filter the Lig[ht out] [L10] of the creation. The wandering itself, with the produ[ce ...] [L11] [Deep]. The mystery of the [m]olding of Adam, the fir[st m]an. [L12] He told me also the mystery of the Tree of Knowledge [from] [L13] which Adam ate; his eyes saw outward. The myster[y al]so [L14] of the apostles who are sent into the worl[d, that they may] [L15] choose the churches; the mystery of the Elect [with their] [L16] commandments; {{[the mystery of the sinners with their wo[rks]]}} (scribal deletion) [L17] [the] mystery of the catechumens, the helpers, with [their] [L18] commandments; the mystery of the sinners with their works [L19] and the punishment that is laid up for them. Thus everything that has [com]e [L20] to be and that which shall come to be was revealed to me by the Paraclete of [...]. [L21] Everything which the eye looks upon, and the ear hears, and the re- [L22] flection reflects upon, and the [...] [...]: I knew through it. [L23] Everything I saw — I beheld the All through him; I became one body [L24] with one spirit.

[L24] In the last years of Arta[xshathra] [L25] the king, I came forth to preach. I sailed to the country of the Indians; I [L26] preached to them the hope of life. I chose in that place [L27] a beautiful election.

[L27] But in that very year [in which Ar-] [L28] [tax]shathra the king died, Shapur his son became king [...]. [L29] I sailed from the country of the Indians to the land of the Persians; from the [L30] land of Persia I came to the land of Babylon, Mes[ene], [L31] and the country of (Beth-)Hozeos. I appeared before Shapur the king; he [...] [L32] received me with great honor. He gave me leave to traverse [...] [L33] [...prea]ching the word of life. I spent some other yea[rs] [L34] [following h]im in the comitatus, many years in [...]
